passport.text: Ka taea e ahau te kite i to koutou uruwhenua, tēnā?

early_checkin.text: Ka rite to koutou whare i roto i te haora. E hiahia ana koe ki te tatari i roto i te wharepaku?

umbrella.text: He ua: Ka taea e au te tuku i tetahi paraihe ki a koe?

pillow_menu.text: Tenei ko to tatou tahua pouow. ko tehea e hiahia ana koe?

wifi.text: Ka kitea te waehere Wi-Fi i runga i te mahere tata ki te waea.

table_tonight.text: E hiahia ana koe ki te pupuri i te tepu mo koutou i tenei po?

breakfast_time.text: Ka tukuna te kai kai mai i te 7:00 am ki te 11:00 am.

room_service.text: Kei te wātea te ratonga ruma i te ao me te po.

bill_room.text: Me hoatu e ahau te pire i runga i tou ruma?

spa_booking.text: E hiahia ana koe ki te tono i te maimoatanga spa?

massage_pressure.text: E pai ana koe ki te pēhanga ngawari, waenga, kaha ranei?

health_conditions.text: Kei a koe etahi raruraru hauora e hiahia ana te tākuta ki te mohio?

fix_now.text: Ka tiaki ahau i te reira tonu.

change_room.text: Ka taea e matou te tuku atu ki a koe tetahi atu waahanga, kaore he utu taapiri.

doctor.text: E hiahia ana koe ki te karanga i te tākuta?

noise.text: E pouri ana matou mo te tangi. Ka uru atu matou ki a ia i te wa tonu.

invoice_email.text: E hiahia ana koe ki te tiki i te pire mā te īmēra?
